items.title: Berkshire Hathaway latest: Q3 earnings, top 5 holdings, record stock buyback, & more
items.summary:
Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-B, BRK-A) reported third quarter earnings results and bought a record $9.6 billion of its own shares.

"The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley take a closer look at the results.

items.title: Berkshire May Be Buying Class A Stock Directly From Holders to Boost Repurchases
items.summary: During the third quarter, Berkshire repurchased $9.6 billion of stock. Most consisted of the more liquid Class B shares, but some $3.4 billion involved the A stock.

items.title: Berkshire Kept Buying Back Stock as Shares Hit Records. Here’s What the Price It Paid Tells You.
items.summary: Berkshire’s own filing shows the prices at which management found its stock attractive, and how far the shares have climbed since.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Nvidia, AMD, Skydance
items.summary: ↘️ Nvidia (NVDA): Shares in the chip giant slid 4.3% after it said it would launch an investigation into reports that CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign espionage effort.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway May Have Sold More Bank of America Stock in the Third Quarter
items.summary: Berkshire’s quarterly filing offers clues to possible Bank of America sales and additional Alphabet purchases ahead of its portfolio disclosure.

items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Jumps, These Stocks Test Entries; Warren Buffett Play Clears Buy Zone
items.summary: The Dow Jones index rallied Monday as Nvidia dived on a probe into CEO Jensen Huang. Multiple stocks cleared buy points.

items.title: Jim Cramer Questions Berkshire’s “Ill-Advised Position” in Alphabet as Its Cash Flow Turns Negative
items.summary: Key TakeawaysJim Cramer questioned Berkshire Hathaway’s $10 billion stake in Alphabet on the day Berkshire reported its third-quarter results. Alphabet’s free cash flow was negative $9.

items.title: Warren Buffett's Rule for Stock Buybacks Is Very Specific. Berkshire Spent a Record $9.6 Billion on Them Last Quarter.
items.summary: The rule boils down to two tests. Would the stock still pass them at today's price?
